newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won closes lower on import demand.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won closes lower on import demand.

text.p: The won fell versus the dollar on Friday as banks rushed to cover corporate importer settlements, dealers said.
The won finished at 828.50 after opening at an intraday high of 827.00.
An afternoon newspaper report that the government considered 850 as the won's adequate level took the local currency to its intraday low of 831.50.
But the report was later denied by the government and the won managed to escape from its low.
